observations: Photo 0 shows a complete car engine assembly on the ground (intake/exhaust manifolds, wiring/hoses, and engine block visible).
No readable brand/model markings are visible in the photo at this resolution/angle.
Seller text says 'We sell direct Korean parts', but the photo does not clearly show 'Korean' branding.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not show any readable Korean branding/part numbers or documentation to confirm origin.

risks.risk: Engine model/variant is not identifiable from the photo, so the exact fitment and expected price tier is uncertain.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the engine identification plate/engine code (e.g., stamped code on block) and the full label/part number.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used/unknown engine assembly with no confirmed engine code (worst-case fitment uncertainty).

risks.risk: Condition/working status is unknown (could be incomplete, damaged, or not running).
risks.proof: A short video of the engine running (or a test/inspection sheet showing compression/diagnostic results).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst-case: treat as not guaranteed to run).

risks.risk: Completeness is uncertain (missing sensors, alternator, starter, ECU, hoses, or accessories).
risks.proof: Photos laid out showing all accessories included, plus a checklist of what comes with the engine (starter/alternator/ECU/injectors/sensors).
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown completeness (worst-case: assume missing some accessories).

risks.risk: Compatibility with the buyer’s vehicle is unknown (wrong engine family/year/variant).
risks.proof: Photo of the engine code + the vehicle it was removed from (VIN/registration or at least make/model/year) or a fitment statement with engine code match.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case mismatch risk (assume buyer may need additional parts).

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the engine code/ID plate stamped on the block (and any part-number label).
Video of the engine running (or compression/test results) to confirm working status.
Photos showing what accessories are included (starter, alternator, ECU, sensors, intake/exhaust components) and what is missing.
response.reason: The photo shows an engine assembly, but the engine code/variant and working condition are not readable/confirmed, so a reliable worst-case price cannot be matched to the correct comparable tier.
